data.sections.action.text.description: アクションにラベルを付けます。動的テキストをサポートします
data.sections.action.textPostFix.descrip: 接尾辞として表示されるテキスト、textAddUnitNameと一緒に使用してテキストUIを作成するのに便利です
data.sections.action.text_{LANG}.descrip: 異なる言語の代替テキスト。{LANG}接頭辞にISO 639-1言語コードを使用します。動的テキストをサポートします
data.sections.action.description.descrip: ユニットのアクションを選択するときの表示テキスト、その目的を説明するために使用されます。動的テキストをサポートします
異なる言語の代替説明。{LANG}接頭辞にISO 639-1言語コードを使用します。動的テキストをサポートします
data.sections.action.displayType.descrip: アクションボタンとテキストの表示方法に影響します。オプション: none, rally, upgrade, queueUnit, building, action, infoOnly, infoOnlyNoBox, infoOnlyStockpile
data.sections.action.displayRemainingSto: 残りのストックパイルを表示
キューは価格に基づいてアクションがトリガーできる回数として表示されます。代替としてtextに動的テキストを使用します。
data.sections.action.pos.description: アクションがUIに表示される順序。canBuildボタンの位置とマージされます
data.sections.action.iconImage.descripti: アクションボタンのサムネイル画像を設定します
data.sections.action.iconExtraImage.desc: アイコン画像の上に描画されます。アップグレードアイコンなどに便利です
data.sections.action.iconExtraIsVisible: アイコン追加が表示可能
条件が満たされたとき、アイコンの追加が表示されます。
data.sections.action.unitShownInUI: UIに表示されるユニット
data.sections.action.unitShownInUI.descr: このユニットを表示します。(このアクションがこのユニットをビルドしたかのように)
data.sections.action.guiBuildUnit.descri: 構造物をビルドするときと同様のUIを使用します。一部のケースでfireTurretXの代替
data.sections.action.setBuilt.descriptio: 0-100%のパーセンテージでユニットがどの程度ビルドされたかを指定します(0から1の間の数値)
data.sections.action.tags.description: self.queueSize(withTag=x)およびqueueItemAddedとqueueItemCanceledイベントのwithTagパラメータで使用します
data.sections.action.id.description: ユニット間の変換時に同じ/同等のアクションをより簡単に接続し、キュー、カルダウンなどを保持できるようにします。(通常アクション順序が使用されますが、不安定になる可能性があります)
data.sections.action.textAddUnitName: テキストにユニット名を追加
data.sections.action.textAddUnitName.des: このユニットの名前をこのアクションのテキストに追加します
data.sections.action.descriptionAddFromU: 説明にユニットから追加
このユニットの説明をこのアクションの説明に追加します
data.sections.action.descriptionAddUnitS: 説明にユニット統計を追加
このユニットの統計(例: HP、エネルギー、リソース)をこのアクションの説明に追加します
data.sections.action.unitShownInUIWithHp: HPバー付きでUIに表示されるユニット
デフォルトはtrue、unitShownInUIがunitRefの場合のみ使用されます
data.sections.action.unitShownInUIWithPr: プログレスバー付きでUIに表示されるユニット
デフォルトはtrue、unitShownInUIがunitRefの場合のみ使用されます。アクティブな場合HPバーを置き換えます
data.sections.action.alwaysSinglePress.d: デフォルトはfalse。trueの場合モバイルで確認が必要なく、canPlayerCancel:falseとallowMultipleInQueue:falseと一緒に使用するとキューインターフェースも非表示になります。
data.sections.action.price.description: ユニットのアクションの価格。利用できない場合アクションを無効化します。ラベルなしの場合デフォルトでクレジット
data.sections.action.isActive.descriptio: デフォルトはtrue。falseの場合アクションは無効化され、UIで赤色で表示されます。
data.sections.action.isVisible.descripti: デフォルトはtrue。falseの場合アクションはUIから非表示になり、無効化されます。
data.sections.action.isLocked.descriptio: デフォルトはfalse。trueの場合アクションは無効化され、ロックアイコンが表示されます。主に核なしゲームモードで使用されます
data.sections.action.isLockedMessage.des: isLockedの条件が満たされたときにメッセージを表示します
data.sections.action.isLockedAlt.descrip: ロックされる別の理由。isLockedでORを使用できますが、これにより異なるメッセージを表示できます
data.sections.action.isLockedAltMessage: ロック代替メッセージ
data.sections.action.isLockedAlt2Message: ロック代替2メッセージ
data.sections.action.allowMultipleInQueu: falseの場合、このタイプのアクションは1つだけキューに入れることができます(条件付きアクションがスパムされるのを防ぐのに便利)
アクションがUIで選択されたとき、選択されたユニットのうち1つだけがこのアクションを取得します。デフォルトはfalse。
data.sections.action.isGuiBlinking.descr: UIで点滅して注意を引きます。頻繁に使用すると迷惑になる可能性があります、一時的な状態/メッセージにのみ推奨されます
data.sections.action.isAlsoViewableByAll: 同盟プレイヤーがこのユニットのアクションを見られるようにします、他のプレイヤーに統計を表示するのに便利です(例: ミサイル数、収集されたアイテム)
data.sections.action.isAlsoViewableByEne: 敵プレイヤーがこのユニットのアクションを見られるようにします、他のプレイヤーに統計を表示するのに便利です(例: ミサイル数、収集されたアイテム)
data.sections.action.ai_isHighPriority.d: 派閥選択アクションや高優先度のユニットをビルドするなどの高優先度アクションに使用します
data.sections.action.ai_isDisabled.descr: デフォルトはfalse。AIがこのアクションを使用しないようにします。(ai_isHighPriorityがtrueの場合、これは無視される可能性があります)
data.sections.action.autoTriggerOnEvent: イベントで自動トリガー
特定のユニットでイベントが発生したときにアクションがトリガーされます。オプション: created, completeAndActive, destroyed, killedAnyUnit, queuedUnitFinished, queueItemAdded(withActionTag="#"), queueItemCancelled(withActionTag="#"), teleported, touchTargetSuccess, newWaypointGivenByPlayer, teamChanged, transportingNewUnit, transportUnloadedOrRemovedUnit, tookDamage(withTag="#"), newMessage(withTag="#"), enteredTransport, leftTransport, attachmentRemoved。tookDamageのwithTagパラメータはprojectileのタグを使用し、オプションです。newMessageのwithTagパラメータはメッセージタグを使用します。
data.sections.action.autoTriggerOnEventR: イベント自動トリガー再帰制限
デフォルトは1。ループを防ぎ、自分自身をトリガーする場合に無限にトリガーしないようにします、イベントでアクション効果を繰り返すのに適しています
data.sections.action.autoTrigger.descrip: trueの場合、このアクションの効果を即座にトリガーします(価格、isActive、isVisible、buildSpeedなどを無視)
data.sections.action.autoTriggerCheckRat: オプション: everyFrame (デフォルト), every4Frames, every8Frames。[core]に設定されたautoTriggerCheckRateをオーバーライドします。注: 確認率に関係なく、すべてのトリガーは最初に作成されたときと自動トリガー冷却後に確認されます。注: all-units.templateに[core]autoTriggerCheckRate:every8Framesを追加すると、複雑なautoTriggersを持つMODに大きなパフォーマンス向上をもたらす可能性があります。
data.sections.action.buildSpeed.descript: アクションの動作を行う前にアクションをキューに入れる速さを設定します
data.sections.action.highPriorityQueue.d: デフォルトはfalse。trueの場合このアクションはキュー内の他のすべての低優先度アクションをスキップします。fireTurretアクションに便利です。
data.sections.action.canPlayerCancel: プレイヤーがキャンセル可能
data.sections.action.canPlayerCancel.des: デフォルトはtrue。falseの場合、プレイヤーはこの特定のアクションをキャンセルできません。
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_cannot: アクションが適用されている間ユニットの移動を停止します。展開のようなアクションに便利です。
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_playAn: ビルド時アニメーション再生
アクションがキューに入っている間、指定されたアニメーションを再生します。
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_rotate: アクションがアクティブキューにあるとき、ユニット本体をこの方向に回転します。
data.sections.action.addActionCooldownAp: Add Action Cooldown Apply To Actions
Sets addActionCooldownTime's target. Defaults to this action.
data.sections.action.addActionCooldownTi: Player cannot use action again for this amount of time
data.sections.action.addAllActionCooldow: Adds cooldown on all actions, including canBuilds
data.sections.action.addEnergy.descripti: Adds energy to unit. Has no effect unless energyMax is set. (Same as addResources: energy=X)
data.sections.action.addGlobalTeamTags.d: Add a tag to player's team. Use with self.globalTeamTags() to create unlocks and upgrades. Unique tags are best to not conflict with other mods.
data.sections.action.addResources.descri: Add these resources when action finishes.
data.sections.action.addResourcesScaledB: Add Resources Scaled By AI Handicaps
Same as addResources, but increased or decreased depending on AI difficulty level.
data.sections.action.addResourcesWithLog: Like addResources but allows logic to be used for the resource value
data.sections.action.addUnitsIntoTranspo: Creates and add units into transport, use self.transportingCount() to check for space before adding
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_maxTime: Automatically remove this waypoint if it has been active for longer than this time.
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_positio: Puts the waypoint taken from an action that triggered this action
Add Waypoint Position Offset From Self
Puts the waypoint to an absolute coordinate
Add Waypoint Position Random Offset From Self
Puts the waypoint to a random relative coordinate
Add Waypoint Position Relative Offset From Self
Puts the waypoint to a relative coordinate
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_prepend: Add to the start of the waypoint queue or the end
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_target_: Puts the waypoint to a marker or a reference unit
Add Waypoint Target Map Must Be Reachable
Puts the waypoint only if the waypoint target is reachable by the unit (e.g., if a unit cannot cross two islands, the waypoint is not placed.)
Add Waypoint Target Nearest Unit Max Range
Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit within the maximum range specified.
Add Waypoint Target Nearest Unit Tagged
Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit with specific tags
Add Waypoint Target Nearest Unit Team
Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit with a specific relation to the player's unit. Options: own, neutral, allyNotOwn, ally, enemy, any, notOwn
Add Waypoint Target Random Unit Max Range
Puts the waypoint to a random unit within the maximum range specified.
Add Waypoint Target Random Unit Tagged
Puts the waypoint to a random unit with specific tags
Add Waypoint Target Random Unit Team
Puts the waypoint to a random unit with a specific relation to the player's unit. Options: own, neutral, allyNotOwn, ally, enemy, any, notOwn
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_trigger: Add Waypoint Trigger Action If Failed
If target_nearestUnit fails to find a match so waypoint cannot be added then trigger this action
Add Waypoint Trigger Action If Matched
Triggers an action if a waypoint is legal
data.sections.action.addWaypoint_type.de: Adds a waypoint with a specific purpose. Options: move, attackMove, guard, loadInto, loadUp, attack, reclaim, repair, touchTarget, build, follow, setPassiveTarget
data.sections.action.alsoQueueAction.des: Adds another action into the normal unit's queue. Ignores action's requirements
data.sections.action.alsoTriggerAction.d: Trigger to results of another action as well. Ignores action's requirements.
data.sections.action.alsoTriggerActionRe: Repeats the alsoTriggerAction call, thisActionIndex changed on each repeat - Useful to create loops or work with arrays
data.sections.action.alsoTriggerOrQueueA: Also Trigger Or Queue Action Conditional
Defaults true. alsoTriggerAction and alsoQueueAction are ignored if this works out to be false.
Also Trigger Or Queue Action With Target
Changes the target of the triggered action, normally defaults to the current action target. Effects things like fireTurretXAtGround, spawnUnits, thisActionTarget(), etc
data.sections.action.attachments_deleteN: Removes a specified amount of units attached
data.sections.action.attachments_disconn: Disconnect all attachments in the place they are right now. Can be used with attachments_onlyOnSlots.
data.sections.action.attachments_onlyOnS: Restrict attachments_* actions to these attachments
Unload all attachments. Can be used with attachments_onlyOnSlots. Same as unloading transported units
data.sections.action.clearAllActionCoold: Removes all existing cooldowns on all buttons
data.sections.action.clearAllWaypoints.d: Clears all waypoints, be careful not to annoy players by removing their orders, prepending waypoints is often better
data.sections.action.convertResource_fro: Name of custom resource to take from
data.sections.action.convertResource_max: Max amount to transfer between 'from' and 'to'
data.sections.action.convertResource_min: Skip if less than this amount in 'from'. Defaults to 0. Likely not needed for most use cases
data.sections.action.convertResource_mul: Defaults to 1. Amount to multiply when adding on 'to' (does not effect amount taken on 'from')
Name of custom resource to give to
data.sections.action.convertTo.descripti: Convert your unit into another unit. properties are preserved.
data.sections.action.convertTo_keepCurre: Don't change these fields when converting, useful with setUnitStats (Allowed fields: maxHp, maxEnergy, moveSpeed)
Keep current and temporarily tags and ignores default tags on convertTo target.
data.sections.action.debugMessage.descri: Only shows in Sandbox with Debug mode on.
data.sections.action.deleteNumUnitsFromT: Removes a specified amount of cargo units
Delete Num Units From Transport Only With Tags
Removes a specified amount of cargo units, but only those with specified tags
data.sections.action.deleteSelf.descript: Remove self with no explosions or sounds
data.sections.action.disconnectFromParen: Disconnects this unit from parent's attachment slot
data.sections.action.finishPlayingLastAn: Finish last animation, including blend out
data.sections.action.fireTurretXAtGround: Fire Turret X At Ground Count
Number of projectiles to fire. Defaults to 1
When action finishes fire target turret at point on ground, bypasses canShoot rules in turret.
Fire Turret X At Ground Only Over Passable Tile Of
Only allow tiles crossable by this movement type to be selected (e.g., LAND,BUILDING,WATER,HOVER)
Fire Turret X At Ground Show Guide Decals
Draws decals at the target location. Recommend setting up decals with layer: inactive
Fire Turret X At Ground With Offset
If not set player targets the ground with GUI, if a point is set this step is skipped
Fire Turret X At Ground With Projectile
Used with fireTurretXAtGround. Defaults to target turret's normal projectile.
Fire Turret X At Ground With Target
Fires a turret aimed at the location of the indicated unit or marker
data.sections.action.forceUnloadTranspor: For unload all units, or slot targeted by forceUnloadTransportNow_onlyOnSlot. Unloads even if no space or overwater, etc
Force Unload Transport Now Only On Slot
Focuses the force unload to a specific slot
Offsets unit position absolutely by this point. Format: [x,y,height]
data.sections.action.playAnimation.descr: Plays animation when the action is triggered
data.sections.action.playAnimationIfNotP: Don't restart animation if this animation is already playing
data.sections.action.playSoundAtUnit.des: Local sound to play when action finishes
data.sections.action.playSoundGlobally.d: Global sound to play to all players in game
data.sections.action.playSoundToPlayer.d: Global sound to play to unit's player only
data.sections.action.playSoundToPlayerOn: Play Sound To Player On Queue
Global sound to play to unit's player only when action is first added to queue
data.sections.action.produceUnits.descri: Like spawnUnits but unit exits as if it was produced normally, and gets a move away waypoint
data.sections.action.refundAllQueuedItem: Refunds the spent price in the queue of a specific action; Includes set flags in price
data.sections.action.removeAllQueuedItem: Remove All Queued Items Without Refund
Similar to refundAllQueuedItems, but does not refund
data.sections.action.removeGlobalTeamTag: Remove a tag from player's team.
Skip all effects of this action if this evaluates to false
data.sections.action.resetUnitStats.desc: Reset changes made by setUnitStats to base values
data.sections.action.resourceAmount_addO: Name of another custom resource to add to this on. Can be used without resourceAmount_setValue, to just add resources. Or with resourceAmount_setValue:0 to copy a resource value.
data.sections.action.resourceAmount.desc: Name of custom resource to set with the below 3 keys. All keys are optional, and can be used together.
data.sections.action.resourceAmount_mult: Defaults to 1. Multiple the current or new value by
data.sections.action.resourceAmount_setV: Absolute value to set this resource to, ignores current value of resource. Skipped by default
data.sections.action.sendMessageTo.descr: Sends a message to a targeted unit
data.sections.action.sendMessageWithData: The data that will be sent to the targeted unit. Allows multiple key-value pairs with any dynamic data type, use eventData() to read this data in the event
data.sections.action.sendMessageWithTags: Useful for message detection in an autoTriggerOnEvent event, eg autoTriggerOnEvent:newMessage(withTag='xyz')
data.sections.action.setBodyRotation.des: Rotates the unit to a particular direction. Supports dynamic values
data.sections.action.setCustomTarget1.de: Used for unit linking without requiring unit memories or markers. It is the unit that built this by default.
data.sections.action.setCustomTarget2.de: Like setCustomTarget1 and with the same use. It is none by default.
data.sections.action.setHeight.descripti: Changes unit height based on this height value
data.sections.action.setResourcesWithLog: Sets target resources to this value instead of adding. Becareful with global resources.
data.sections.action.setUnitMemory.descr: Change this unit's memory, values can be set with logic. Memory must first be defined with defineUnitMemory
data.sections.action.setUnitStats.descri: Allows changing of a select number of fields dynamically without converting. Supports =/+=/-=, with dynamic maths/logic. Changeable fields: maxHp, hp, maxShield, shield, shieldRegen, maxEnergy, energy, armour, mass, shootDelayMultiplier, moveSpeed, maxTurnSpeed, maxAttackRange, fogOfWarSightRange, nanoRange, selfRegenRate, targetHeight, nanoFactorySpeed. (targetHeight adjust the unit's height gradually relative to its current height, unlike setting it with setHeight)
data.sections.action.showMessageToAllEne: Show Message To All Enemy Players
Sends a message to all enemy players only
data.sections.action.showMessageToAllPla: Sends a message to all players
data.sections.action.showMessageToPlayer: Sends a message to the player controlling the unit
Note: This format is support on nearly all strings that show to player even when reference doesn't show it. Use ISO 639-1 Language Code on the {LANG} placeholder
data.sections.action.showQuickWarLogToAl: Show Quick War Log To All Players
Sends a Quick War Log message to all players (in the lower lef)
data.sections.action.showQuickWarLogToPl: Show Quick War Log To Player
Sends a Quick War Log message to the player controlling the unit (in the lower lef)
data.sections.action.spawnEffectsOnQueue: Effects to spawn at unit when action is first added to queue
data.sections.action.spawnUnits.descript: Spawn units at action's target. See 'Spawn units line' section in this doc for details.
data.sections.action.stopLastAnimation.d: Stop last animation, skipping blend out
data.sections.action.switchToAggressiveT: Change to a built-in team that is aggressive to all other teams. Does not get captured.
data.sections.action.switchToNeutralTeam: Change team to neutral. This team is allied to all other teams. Will be captured by nearby units unless [core]stayNeutral:true is used
data.sections.action.switchToTeam.descri: Team id to switch to. Starts at 0. (but -1 for a neutral team, -2 for aggressive Team). Also supports dynamic values
data.sections.action.takeResources.descr: Resources to take (required to use take resources). And at-least 1 include key is needed.
data.sections.action.takeResources_direc: Take Resources Direct Transfer Stopping At Zero
If less resources on target than transfer amount, only remaining resources will be transfered. Doesn't support use with some other takeResources_* keys
data.sections.action.takeResources_disca: Just take resources from targets, don't add(or remove) to self
data.sections.action.takeResources_exclu: Take Resources Exclude Units Without All Resources
Take Resources Exclude Units Without Tags
Excludes all units without the specified tags in taking resources
Take Resources Exclude Units With These Resources
Excludes all units with custom prices in them
data.sections.action.takeResources_inclu: Include attachment parent or transport parent
Includes referenced units in taking resources
Take Resources Include Units In Transport
Includes cargo units in taking resources
Take Resources Include Units Within Range
Includes all units within the specified range
Take Resources Include Units Within Range Team
Used with includeUnitsWithinRange, defaults to own. Can be:  own|ally|allyNotOwn|enemy|neutral|any
data.sections.action.takeResources_keepR: Take Resources Keep Resources On Target
Don't add/remove resource from target. This clones resources. Use with takeResources_discardCollected and takeResources_triggerActionIfAnyCollected to make a resource detector.
data.sections.action.takeResources_maxUn: Defaults to 1. Takes resources from specified amount of units
data.sections.action.takeResources_searc: Shortcut for maxUnits: 200, discardCollected: true, keepResourcesOnTarget: true to detect resources only
data.sections.action.takeResources_trigg: Take Resources Trigger Action For Each
Calls this action for each unit found by takeResource with the unit as thisActionTarget, and thisActionIndex counting up from zero.
Take Resources Trigger Action If Any Collected
Triggers an action if any amount of resources is collected in the current collection action
Take Resources Trigger Action If None Collected
Triggers an action if no amount of resources is collected in the current collection action
data.sections.action.teleportTo.descript: Changes unit position to this position. Great alternative to fireTurretX with teleporting projectile
Add tag to this unit until it is converted or reset (unless convertTo_keepCurrentTags is used)
data.sections.action.temporarilyRemoveTa: Remove tag from this unit until it is converted or reset (unless convertTo_keepCurrentTags is used)
{Currently broken in 1.15 - don't use} Instantly tries to transports existing units on the map into this transport. Might fail if rules don't allow this unit to be transported.
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_rotate: When Building Rotate To Aim At Action Target
While action is queued, the unit is rotated to the target. Often used with fireTurretX actions
When Building Rotate To Or Backwards
If true allow rotation in 180 degrees from whenBuilding_rotateTo when this is a smaller angle
When Building Rotate To Rotate Turret X
While action is queued, a specified turret is aimed at the target. Often used with fireTurretX actions
When Building Rotate To Wait Till Rotated
Pause action queue till rotation is finished
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_tempor: Convert to another unit while action is in active queue. Note: actions from the original unit will be kept
When Building Temporarily Convert To Keep Fields
Don't change these fields when using whenBuilding_temporarilyConvertTo (both to and from)
data.sections.action.whenBuilding_trigge: While action is queued, another action is triggered.
